audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer disagreement across the whole chart: phases[0..6].side all read Syndra while win[0..6] all read Cassiopeia, and both the phases[].why and whys[] sentences described Cassiopeia winning every stage.
audit.why: Cassiopeia wins 45.6% over 1568 games and the page already grades the lane HARD 8/10, so the Syndra sides are right and the content layer plus every why was the error.
audit.corrected: win[0..6] flipped to Syndra to match the sides, and all seven phases[].why plus all seven whys[] rewritten to explain Syndra winning that stage, grounded in Dark Sphere (7s, 800), Scatter the Weak (15s, 650) and Unleashed Power.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said her ult leaves her 'playing scared', which contradicts a losing lane and omits the execute.
audit.why: Unleashed Power executes low-health targets at 675 range and Transcendent adds true damage.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten around the execute threshold and true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma was sold as the answer ('grounds dashes', 'anti-dive') against a champion with no dash, and nothing recorded that Transcendent/Force of Will deal true damage.
audit.why: Syndra's kit has no movement ability, so grounding does nothing to her; her passive upgrades Force of Will to bonus true damage, which resistances do not reduce.
audit.corrected: Stated that Miasma only gives slow value here, that her true damage ignores MR, and that Scatter the Weak's flat 15s cooldown is the window to close to 700.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Scatter the Weak flat 15s, Dark Sphere 7s, Force of Will 12s at rank 1, Petrifying Gaze 120s at rank 1.

notes: Syndra is female — nine misgendered fields fixed. The big correction is the chart: sides said Syndra on all seven rows while win[N] said Cassiopeia on all seven, and every why on both layers argued Cassiopeia was winning. At 45.6% over 1568 games with the page graded HARD 8/10 I moved the content layer and both sets of whys to match the Syndra sides rather than the reverse. Miasma's grounding is dead weight here — Syndra has no movement ability in her kit — so I recast W as a slow/peel tool only. Left phases[N].rating alone. Not verifiable from the kit and therefore not written: the exact execute threshold on Unleashed Power, and whether Scatter the Weak's stun applies through spell shield.
